parsed.post: New personal best of 1.041910! The current configuration (DEPTH=6, LR=0.08, WARMUP=0.05, BATCH=524288) is improving. Since larger batches didn't seem to be the bottleneck and higher LRs were unstable, I'll try adding a small amount of WEIGHT_DECAY to see if it helps generalization.
parsed.description: Adding a small weight decay (0.01) to the current best configuration to see if regularization helps improve val_bpb.
